meta.title: Static Analysis Audit: Live Trading Core
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Run static analysis tools (ruff, mypy) on core live trading modules and capture all findings in the structured YAML format created in Story 10.1.1.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: ruff check passes on live/engine.py with zero errors (or all findings documented)
ruff check passes on live/order_manager.py with zero errors (or all findings documented)
ruff check passes on live/state_manager.py with zero errors (or all findings documented)
mypy passes on all three modules (or all type errors documented)
All findings captured in core_findings.yaml with severity classification
Each finding includes specific line numbers and recommendations

key-tasks.task: Run ruff check on live/engine.py and document findings
Run ruff check on live/order_manager.py and document findings
Run ruff check on live/state_manager.py and document findings
Run mypy on all three modules and document type errors

architecture-context.pattern: ruff: Python linter for style and potential bugs mypy: Static type checker for Python
architecture-context.constraint: All CRITICAL/HIGH findings must be resolved before Epic 10.1 completes

technical-specifications.spec: ruff check rustybt/live/engine.py ruff check rustybt/live/order_manager.py ruff check rustybt/live/state_manager.py mypy rustybt/live/engine.py rustybt/live/order_manager.py rustybt/live/state_manager.py

dependencies.dependency: Audit infrastructure and findings schema must exist

nfr-references.nfr: All order state transitions logged for audit
